Comment: ConQ Document Processing Pipeline - Workflow Configuration

Stage1.Name: Document Ingestion
Stage1.Description: Downloads document from S3 and prepares for processing

Stage2.Name: Text Extraction
Stage2.Description: Extracts raw text from PDF, DOCX, TXT, HTML using Textract

Stage3.Name: Entity Extraction
Stage3.Description: Extracts named entities, key phrases, sentiment using Comprehend

Stage4.Name: AI Summarization
Stage4.Description: Generates document summary and classification using Bedrock Claude

Stage5.Name: Tag Generation
Stage5.Description: Auto-generates tags from entities, keywords, and AI analysis

Stage6.Name: Store Results
Stage6.Description: Persists structured results to ConQInsights DynamoDB table

ErrorHandling.FailureAction: Update DynamoDB with FAILED status and error message
